evidence.detail: The class configures Swing tooltip policy and UIManager defaults for tabbed panes, buttons, panels and text selections, and sets popup/background system properties.
It installs LookAndFeel with fallback logging, propagates a FontUIResource across UI defaults, normalizes AbstractButton chrome, and creates icon-backed buttons with callbacks/tooltips.
It creates/adds TrayIcon instances, enables auto-size, logs AWT failures and attaches rs/gui/N to restore the supplied Frame.
All methods are static desktop/Swing presentation helpers; the class owns no gameplay or protocol state.

candidates.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for the shared Swing/desktop presentation utility surface.

evidence.detail: rs/gui/M attaches this MouseAdapter to TrayIcon instances created by its system-tray helper, passing the associated Frame into the listener constructor.
mouseClicked makes the Frame visible and sets its state to NORMAL; on one platform mode it also performs the exact focus/workaround sequence before restoring.
The listener stores only the target Frame and contains no unrelated mouse callbacks or application-domain state.

candidates.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for the generic tray-icon listener that restores a supplied Frame.
